title: Warmly Caramelized Norwegian Chicken Pilaf
description: A tender and flavorful Norwegian dish featuring basmati rice and caramelized chicken, perfect for a family dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the grated carrot to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the basmati rice to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
